message.reasoning_content:
need to determine crime(s). Facts: Defendant set fire to a house, causing property damage, but no serious consequences? It says "故意放火焚烧他人财物，危害公共安全，尚未造成严重后果". That corresponds to crime of "放火" (arson). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 132 (放火罪). Also possibly "毁灭财物罪"? But arson is specific. The description: intentionally set fire to others' property, endangering public safety. So crime: "放火". No other crimes like homicide, etc. So single crime.

We must output without "罪". So just "放火". Format: [罪名]放火<eoa>
